title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Ab Ag Threshold

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Quantitative antigen and antibody tests: Serology qualitative — threshold presence of a pathogen antibody or antigen', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. The qualitative counterpart (ordinal/semi-quantitative presence). Belongs to 'specific determination' in the 2027 module, listed here for the review split quantitative vs qualitative. Parts: LOINC enumeration (2785, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (11), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)|), 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = (<< 312301006 |Infective organism antibody (substance)| OR << 116633006 |Microbial antigen (substance)|)`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
